title: Lithos Configuration
description: Unified configuration schema for global and vault-level Lithos config files. Supports TOML, YAML, and JSON formats. Some fields are context-specific: 'vault_path', 'name', 'version', and 'cache_dir' apply only to vault configs; 'trusted_vaults' applies only to global configs. For vault configs, 'vault_path' is required. Defaults shown reflect Rust implementation in lithos-core/src/config/raw.rs.

vault_path.title: Vault Path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to the vault root directory. Required for vault configs (ignored in global config). This identifies where the vault is located on disk.

name.title: Vault Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for the vault. Vault-only field (ignored in global config). If omitted, defaults to the vault root directory name.

version.title: App Version
version.description: Lithos schema version this vault is compatible with. Vault-only field (ignored in global config). If omitted, defaults to the current Lithos version.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Verbosity of log output. Use 'none' to disable logging entirely.

paths.title: Path Configuration
paths.description: Filesystem paths for Lithos resources. All paths are relative to the vault root.

cache_dir.title: Cache Directory
cache_dir.description: Directory for cached data. Vault-only field (ignored in global config). Must be a relative path without '..' traversal.

templates_dir.title: Templates Directory
templates_dir.description: Directory containing note templates. Must be a relative path without '..' traversal.

schemas_dir.title: Schemas Directory
schemas_dir.description: Directory containing note schemas. Must be a relative path without '..' traversal.

property_bank_file.title: Property Bank File
property_bank_file.description: Filename for the property bank (within the schemas directory). Must not contain path separators.

frontmatter.title: Frontmatter Configuration
frontmatter.description: Customize which keys Lithos looks for when parsing note frontmatter.

file_class_key.title: File Class Key
file_class_key.description: Frontmatter key for the note's schema/file type.

task.title: Task Configuration
task.description: Configure how Lithos recognizes and processes tasks in markdown files.

enabled.title: Task Processing Enabled
enabled.description: Whether to enable task processing for this vault.

task_tags.title: Task Tags
task_tags.description: Hashtags that identify a line as a task. Each tag must start with '#' followed by alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens.

status.title: Checkbox Status Mapping
status.description: Maps status names to checkbox symbols and types. Keys are status names (1-32 chars, alphanumeric/underscore).

use_emoji.title: Use Emoji Task Format
use_emoji.description: If true, parse and emit emoji-based task metadata; if false, use Dataview-style inline fields.

dates.title: Date Field Configuration
dates.description: Configure date fields recognized in task lines.

fields.title: Custom Task Fields
fields.description: User-defined metadata fields for tasks. Field names must be lowercase with letters, digits, or underscores.

indexing.title: Field Indexing
indexing.description: Configure which task fields should be indexed for fast queries.

indexed_fields.title: Indexed Fields
indexed_fields.description: List of field keywords to index. Each must reference a field defined in 'fields'.

trusted_vaults.title: Trusted Vaults
trusted_vaults.description: Global-only field (ignored in vault config). Lists vault paths that are trusted for cross-vault operations. Can be a list of absolute paths or a map of aliases to paths.

oneOf.title: List Format
oneOf.description: Simple list of absolute vault paths.

oneOf.title: Map Format
oneOf.description: Map of aliases to absolute vault paths.

DateFieldSpec.title: Date Field Specification
DateFieldSpec.description: Configuration for a date field in tasks. The field name (due, created, completed, reminder) is used as the keyword in task text.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.description: Optional emoji prefix for visual identification.

format.title: Date Format
format.description: Chrono-compatible format string for parsing the date (e.g., '%Y-%m-%d', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M').

FieldSpec.title: Task Field Specification
FieldSpec.description: Defines a custom metadata field in tasks. The 'type' field determines which other fields are valid.

type.title: Field Type
type.description: The data type of this field.

values.title: Allowed Values
values.description: List of allowed values for this options field.

pattern.title: Validation Pattern
pattern.description: Optional regex pattern for validating string values. Maximum 256 characters.

max.title: Maximum Value
max.description: Maximum allowed value (inclusive). Must be >= min if both specified.

max.title: Maximum Value
max.description: Maximum allowed value (inclusive). Must be >= min if both specified.
